h.t: Questions finance teams ask

items: Does XPensari replace our ERP?
No. XPensari is the AI and finance-operations layer on top of WorkMerate, a customised Odoo ERP, so your ledger and modules stay in one data model.
How does XPensari handle the Nigeria Tax Act 2025?
NTA 2025 rules for VAT, WHT and PAYE are built into the tax engine, and e-invoices go to the NRS gateway system to system.
Can we start with one module?
Yes. Most teams start with the area that hurts most, such as expenses or payables, and add products later on the same data.
